name: Guided Workflow
summary: Step-by-step dunnage receiving workflow covering mode selection, type and part selection, Receiving-style load-count entry, per-load quantity entry, details entry with user-default location fallback plus editable Infor Visual location validation, final review with a save-complete decision dialog, configured part inventory-method propagation, a responsive 3x4 type card selector, weak-event workflow notifications, and module-scoped unsaved state.

workflowAreas: Infor Visual location validation with fuzzy-match recovery
Unsaved state survives only inside the current module
userActions: Set the number of loads and quantity for each load
Leave location blank and still receive a validated default location
Keep an intentionally typed Dunnage location instead of resetting to the fallback default on blur
Recover from mistyped Dunnage locations via fuzzy selection
Lose unsaved work when leaving the module or exiting before save
validationHints: Confirm the Dunnage details step prefills the user default location when the session location is blank
Confirm blank Dunnage locations resolve to the configured user preference and fall back to RECV when no preference is stored
Confirm invalid Dunnage locations are validated against Infor Visual warehouse 002 and offer fuzzy suggestions before Review
Confirm typing a Dunnage location updates the viewmodel immediately and does not revert to RECV when the user tabs away
Confirm the guided workflow still advances correctly between steps
Confirm the type-selection step advances by card click without a separate Next button
Confirm the mode-selection step exposes the same clear-label action available elsewhere in the guided flow
Confirm the part details card includes the selected part's saved specs
Confirm inventoried parts carry their configured inventory method into Details Entry and Review instead of always showing Receive In
Confirm changing the number of loads rebuilds the per-load quantity editors without losing values that still apply
Confirm Enter Loads uses a single combined quantity card and no longer shows the tip card
Confirm each generated load reaches Review with the correct load number and quantity
Confirm Enter Details proceeds directly to Review when validation passes, without an extra confirmation modal
Confirm Review exposes a Back path to Enter Details and shows a completion dialog offering Start New Entry or Mode Selection after save
Confirm the dunnage type selector shows 12 cards per page in a 3x4 layout and scales down cleanly to stay within the card area when the window is resized
Confirm manual and detail entry remain aligned with review behavior
Confirm step-based UI refresh still works after revisiting dunnage views without retaining stale subscribers
Confirm leaving Dunnage before save clears unsaved workflow data
